scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && uv --directory python sync && pnpm --dir web exec playwright install chromium
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c blue,green "pnpm --dir web dev" "uv --directory python run uvicorn api.main:app --reload --reload-dir api/src --port 8000"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir web typecheck && uv --directory python run pyright
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir web lint && eslint scripts && uv --directory python run ruff check .
scripts.test: pnpm --dir web test && uv --directory python run pytest
scripts.db:migrate: uv --directory python run python -m db migrate --target dev
scripts.db:migrate:test: uv --directory python run python -m db migrate --target test
scripts.db:check: uv --directory python run python -m db check --target test
scripts.db:seed: uv --directory python run engine seed fixture
scripts.ingest:games: uv --directory python run engine ingest games
